note: std-zoom over two keyed std-http-client traits: the Server-to-Server account_credentials grant is a keyed POST under a Basic credential the host fills at the boundary (credential-connect cannot express it: the account id rides the query and the client id and secret ride a Basic header, not a JSON body), and the minted access token is held by the one call's row, sent as a bearer header by the API client and cleared with the row; every call is a row of ZoomCall under its own key; each step (token, list pages, meeting, download) retries under keyed std-retry (4 attempts, 100 x 5^(n-1) ms capped at 1500) and the next step starts when std-retry completes the previous run; a download_url is requested on the host it names; a 2xx download answers the raw WebVTT and its plain Speaker: line text. Self-handled internal events (declared -> internal) are consumed by the trait and not listed.
